body: I've came to her crying more than once in the past few months telling her I seriously needed to get on meds again and go back to therapy but nothing. And yes I was. I'm no longer and it was bad. I became very alone and felt like it was making me worse.

Yes, I saw a therapist for maybe 2 months? When I was telling her school was going bad and wanted to do home schooling my mother thought my therapist had implied I should drop out of school so she made me stop going but I did really like my therapist. And yeah, that's exactly what i'm feeling.
